recentItems.title: Coyote vs Acme review: Was it worth the wait?
recentItems.description:
After being shelved by Warner Bros. for three years, Coyote vs Acme has finally arrived in theatres. In the live-action and animated comedy, Wile E. Coyote take the Acme Corporation to court over its faulty products that derailed his pursuit of the Road Runner. The film stars Will Forte, John Cena and Lana Condor. 

A Looney Tunes classic is hitting theatres Friday, with the part live action, part live animation reinventing the beloved cartoon of Wile E. Coyote and Road Runner.

recentItems.title: Canadians living on Trump Avenue now want it renamed
recentItems.description:

The name needs city council's approval — and there's support from officials — but some locals are warning that the move could cause some administrative headaches.

recentItems.title: The science behind​ Nepal's catastrophic flash floods
recentItems.description:
An entire river valley along the Nepal border was wiped out in seconds — but local radar showed no rain, and it wasn't an earthquake. CBC meteorologist Johanna Wagstaffe breaks down how a massive glacier collapse triggered a violent inland tsunami, and why geologists warn this unfolding climate disaster isn't over yet.
